summary: Brain-wave slowing typical of Alzheimer's was found

Most of this recording shows the slower rhythm and weaker front-to-back teamwork seen in Alzheimer's disease. This is not a diagnosis: please see a neurologist (brain specialist) for a full assessment. The mood check is not reliable enough on its own (in testing it was right only about 55% of the time), so please also use a short mood questionnaire such as GDS-15 or PHQ-9. If it shows depression, low mood may be part of the memory problems, and depression is treatable.
